one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window: Q3 FY27 results are due in early December 2026. Items before 2026-10-30: (1) final settlement of the $25B ASR in October (~34M more shares delivered, known and priced); (2) closing of the Contentful and Fin acquisitions (~$5.1B cash, known); (3) macro prints (CPI, FOMC) and software-sector swings on AI-disruption headlines. Corrected price path: after Q2 (Aug 26) the stock peaked at $268.27 intraday on 2026-09-03 (close high $264.43), then fell ~15% to a $225.31 close on 9/29 before $231.31 on 9/30. So most of the post-earnings pop has already reversed. A ~15% give-back in four weeks with no new fundamental news is not a clean momentum or reversal signal I would bet on. The leadership change (effective 2026-08-06) is already old news. I use a near-symmetric lognormal with a median of ~$230.5 (tiny negative drift for skew) and a 12.5% monthly sigma, slightly below 47%/3.5 = 13.4% because no earnings fall in the window, with slightly fattened outer tails.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E on Sep-2027 NTM core EPS (1/3 FY28 $16.25 + 2/3 FY29 $18.15 = ~$17.5) at 14x = $245, and NTM SBC-adjusted FCF per share (~$15.6) at 15.5x = $242; 50/50 weights, giving ~$244.

bear.story: Q3 confirms only ~7-8% organic growth, Agentforce ARR (definition widened to include Slackbot/Headless 360) fails to offset seat compression in Sales/Service, execution slips under a new engineering leader, and the market pays ~10-11x on ~$16 NTM core EPS, as at the June 2026 trough. Leverage (~$33B pro forma net debt) makes it worse.

base.story: Organic growth holds ~8-9% plus M&A, the margin inches up from 34.3%, the ASR cuts the share count ~14%, NTM core EPS reaches ~$17.5 and the multiple holds ~14x.

bull.story: H2 reacceleration (NNAOV best in 4 years, cRPO ~14%) shows up in organic growth, Agentforce/AIforce consumption grows and seats hold; re-rating to ~17.5-18x on ~$17.7 NTM EPS.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$160 (about 10x Sep-2027 NTM core EPS of ~$17.5, and roughly the June 2026 trough multiple) the price would imply that core seat revenue is shrinking or that the FY28 guide (Feb 2027) is below ~7% organic growth, with FCF flat. That is a fundamental break, not ordinary volatility. The ASR average (~$182) would also be deeply underwater on ~$39B of debt. I moved it from $165 to $160 because the corrected NTM EPS and the stock's 47% vol make $165 reachable in a sentiment-only drawdown.

reasoning: Round 2 corrects the two errors the supervisor found. (1) At Sep-2027 the NTM window is ~1/3 FY28 + 2/3 FY29, so NTM core EPS is ~$17.5, not the FY29 $18.3 I used. (2) FY29 growth of +14% 'with buybacks' double counted the ASR; now only ~1.5% ongoing net buyback is added. I also found my own error in the FCF leg: SBC at 9% was applied to too small a FY29 revenue base (~$51B vs ~$56.5B), and it now uses the same NTM blend. Rebuilt: core net income $11.5B -> FY28 $16.25 on 785M -> FY29 $18.15 on 773M -> NTM $17.5 x14 = $245; SBC-adjusted NTM FCF/share ~$15.6 x15.5 = $242; fair value ~$244, vs the supervisor's $251. The gap is mainly the SBC base and my slightly lower multiples, which I keep because of leverage and the leadership change. Alt-data lane: job-market data (SalesforceBen, hiring guides) show Salesforce net-hiring in Agentforce/Data Cloud engineering and 1,000+ Agentforce sellers while support and legacy areas contract. That is consistent with investment, not retrenchment, but it is a lead, not proof of revenue. I no longer let the vendor review blogs or the Substack 'relabel'/'buy band'/'beat' claims move numbers; only the Agentforce ARR definition change is confirmed by the primary release. The leadership 8-K is verified by several press reports and adds a little bear weight. Distribution: 25/50/25 lognormal mixture at $165/$244/$315 (sigmas 30/20/20%), so the median is ~$243, P(>=231) is 0.57, and the upper tail is trimmed versus round 1. Research this round: 2 searches plus the supervisor's evidence.
